+import json
+
+import pytest
+
+from openlibrary.plugins.upstream import checkins
+from openlibrary.plugins.upstream.checkins import (
+    check_ins,
+    make_date_string,
+    patron_check_ins,
+)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ('year', 'month', 'day', 'expected'),
+    [
+        (2000, None, None, '2000'),
+        (2000, 2, None, '2000-02'),
+        (2000, 2, 9, '2000-02-09'),
+        (2000, None, 9, '2000'),
+    ],
+)
+def test_module_date_string(year, month, day, expected):
+    assert make_date_string(year, month, day) == expected
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ('data', 'valid'),
+    [
+        ({'id': 1, 'year': 2020}, True),
+        ({'id': 1, 'data': {}}, True),
+        ({'id': 1, 'year': 2020, 'data': {}}, True),
+        ({'id': 1}, False),
+        ({'year': 2020}, False),
+        ({'id': 1, 'month': 2}, False),
+        ({}, False),
+    ],
+)
+def test_patron_update_validation(data, valid):
+    assert patron_check_ins().is_valid(data) is valid
+
+
+def test_patron_update_rejects_missing_fields_before_lookup(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(checkins.web, 'data', lambda: json.dumps({'id': 1}))
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        checkins.web, 'badrequest', lambda message: ('bad request', message)
+    )
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        checkins, 'get_current_user', lambda: pytest.fail('User lookup should not run')
+    )
+    response = patron_check_ins().POST('alice')
+    assert response == ('bad request', 'Invalid request')
+
+
+def test_patron_update_formats_date_and_updates_data(monkeypatch):
+    changes = []
+    payload = {
+        'id': 1,
+        'year': 2020,
+        'month': 2,
+        'day': 9,
+        'data': {'note': 'read'},
+    }
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        checkins.web,
+        'data',
+        lambda: json.dumps(payload),
+    )
+    monkeypatch.setattr(checkins, 'get_current_user', lambda: {'key': '/people/alice'})
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        checkins.BookshelvesEvents,
+        'select_all_by_username',
+        lambda username: [{'id': 1}],
+    )
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        checkins.BookshelvesEvents,
+        'update_event_date',
+        lambda event_id, date: changes.append(('date', event_id, date)),
+    )
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        checkins.BookshelvesEvents,
+        'update_event_data',
+        lambda event_id, data: changes.append(('data', event_id, data)),
+    )
+    patron_check_ins().POST('alice')
+    assert changes == [
+        ('date', 1, '2020-02-09'),
+        ('data', 1, {'note': 'read'}),
+    ]
